title: 2026 keeper selection (proposed)
decision: Keep Omarion Hampton (RB, LAC) at round 3 and Nico Collins (WR, HOU) at round 2 (second R3 keeper escalates per constitution 5.3.2). Give up picks R2+R3.
rationale: Value board (Sleeper 2026 projections scored with exact league settings, VORP over 2QB replacement): Hampton ranks #16 overall (RB11, 218.9 proj pts) and Collins #20 (WR6, 220.0) — both top-20 values acquired for picks 13-36. Best alternatives are clearly worse: Mahomes costs R2 but projects QB14 (#61 overall, ADP 43 on Sleeper); Evans (R5, #54, injury-questionable) and all others are fair value at best. Cost table verified against ru-ready-keeper-calc.vercel.app. Final declaration pending ADP-lock confirmation by the Draft Czar.

title: 2026 keeper declaration (FINAL)
decision: Robowner declares two keepers: Omarion Hampton (RB, LAC) at a round-3 cost and Nico Collins (WR, HOU) at a round-2 cost (second R3 keeper escalates one round per constitution 5.3.2). Picks surrendered: R2 and R3.
rationale: ADP lock confirmed by the Draft Czar (FFC 2QB snapshot 8/23). Hampton: cost avg(pick 29, ADP 38.5) -> R3; blend rank 25.5 (RB11, 218.9 proj pts under league scoring). Collins: cost avg(pick 20, ADP 36.7) -> R3 escalated to R2; blend rank 26.5 (WR6, 220.0 proj). Both are top-26 consensus values acquired at or below market. Rejected: Mahomes at R2 (blend 43, QB14 projection, Sleeper market ADP 43 vs locked 22.9) and all others as fair-or-worse value. Declared to Draft Czar Emeritus Nate on 2026-08-24.

title: 2026 draft position: taking pick 6 (FINAL)
decision: Offered the earliest (6) or latest (11) available slot, Robowner takes PICK 6.
rationale: Simulated both slots across 17 rounds with our R2+R3 forfeited to keepers, the board rebuilt from current projections scored under league settings blended with 104-expert consensus, and the league keeper landscape modeled (4 teams declared incl. Gibbs and Bowers; the other 8 predicted by value retained). Under an idealized ADP-perfect draft slot 11 edges it by ~4 VORP, but that result does not survive contact with reality: adding realistic draft noise flips it, and slot 6 wins 51-70% of simulated drafts across scenarios. Slot 6 is also far better in the still-open case where fewer elite players get kept (8 of 12 teams have not declared), and it carries no round-1 downside tail — it lands a 90+ VORP player in 100% of simulations vs 98%, with a worst case of 99.2 VORP vs 83.8. With only one pick inside the top 37, protecting that pick matters more than the marginal middle-round gain slot 11 offers. Choosing the option that is better under uncertainty rather than the one that wins narrowly in a single idealized scenario.

title: Draft slot 6 confirmed; keepers declared in Sleeper
decision: Robowner drafts from slot 6. Keepers Omarion Hampton and Nico Collins are formally declared in Sleeper ahead of the Thursday lock-in. Autodraft queue loaded as a fallback.
rationale: The league set the final order and Robowner received pick 6, the earliest available slot it asked for. lotsyrk was the only owner to take the last position, which is why slot 6 rather than 7 came free. Our picks are 6, 43, 54, 67, 78, 91, 102, 115, 126, 139, 150, 163, 174, 187, 198 — rounds 2 and 3 are forfeited to the keepers. Keeper declaration was submitted directly to Sleeper rather than waiting on manual slotting, since the deadline moved to Thursday. A 76-player autodraft queue is loaded, ordered by value under league scoring with kickers and defenses placed last so an unattended autodraft cannot waste an early pick on them.
